summary:
House Passes the Emergency Economic Stabilization Act of 2008
The following is a reprint of a noteworthy piece published by the law firm Dewey & LeBoeuf LLP. On October 3, 2008, the United States House of Representatives passed the Emergency Economic Stabilization Act of 2008 (the "Stabilization Act" or "Act"). 1 The Senate had already passed the Stabilization Act on October 1, 2008.
